period_note: INCOME STATEMENT ONLY -- no balance sheet is available for this period. Midland Bank was not yet listed on the Dhaka Stock Exchange in 2022 (its IPO trading began 2023-03-27, per historical_prices/json_files/MIDLANDBNK.json's earliest record), so no standalone Q1/Q2/Q3 2022 interim financial statement was ever filed with BSEC or published; these figures are the comparative column of the bank's own genuinely-filed Half-Yearly 2023 quarterly report (midlandbnk-half-yearly-2023.txt), which is the earliest surviving disclosure of them, not a contemporaneously-published standalone filing. Because a Mar/Jun/Sep-2022 balance sheet was never part of any surviving comparative (only the Dec-2022 year-end balance sheet appears as a comparative, which is FY2022 Q4/annual, already covered by the existing annual series and not duplicated here), only income-statement line items are included. SOLO / STANDALONE basis (Midland Bank had no Consolidated section in its filings until 2024). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2022. Cross-checked: these figures reproduce identically in the comparative column of the bank's own Q2 2023 filing across the full P&L (interest income, interest expense, NII, investment income, commission/exchange/brokerage, other operating income, total operating income, operating expenses, profit before provision, total provision, profit before tax, tax, profit after tax, EPS) -- internally consistent to the taka.
